decisions.reason: After two years without website evidence, this Magento-specific template looks like a peripheral add-on whose maintenance and versioning needs now outweigh its remaining option value.

The responsive website template is inexpensive to trial but, with no visible follow-up for two years and many comparable alternatives in the market, the firm would likely reallocate attention to stronger core offers.
Premium customer support fits the firm's core service model and existing capabilities so well that, even if the standalone branding shifts, management would keep the underlying offer open.

A software version management tool has strategic logic but also ongoing development cost, and the lack of later visibility suggests the option has not shown enough traction to justify continued standalone commitment.

Because this compliance tool is relatively distant from the hosting core and likely requires continual legal and product updates, two years without evidence make abandonment the more economical choice.

Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship, core-adjacent growth option that matches the firm's direction, customer base, and operational strengths, so management would keep investing unless clear negative evidence appears.
